completed_targets.target: Remove AbortSignal/CancelToken listener leak in sendChatCompletion
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: one leaked 'abort' listener per request pinned to long-lived caller signals; after: axios 1.19 consumes the AbortSignal natively and releases it when the request settles. Zero behavior change for callers (isCancel/aborted error path preserved). Diff: -16/+3 lines in CustomAIClient.js + 3 regression tests (signal passthrough, pre-aborted signal, mid-request abort).
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): pass AbortSignal directly to axios in sendChatCompletion

completed_targets.target: Cancel in-flight BYOK model calls on suspend (parent + sub-agents)
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: customSuspendAiRequest only flipped cache status; the in-flight axios call kept consuming BYOK credits until completion. After: each turn registers an AbortController (keyed by request id, sub-agents remember parentAiRequestId); suspend aborts the parent turn and every child turn; the main chat loop swallows user-initiated aborts and returns the suspended cache copy (no error toast, partial answer not written back). Diff +87/-16 client, +85 tests (2 new: suspend aborts in-flight turn, parent suspend aborts sub-agent).
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): cancel in-flight model turns on suspend

completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: hardcoded 120000ms timeout in sendChatCompletion hard-killed slow local models mid-agent-loop with a generic axios message. After: CustomAIConfig.timeoutMs (optional, positive-number validated, default 120000) flows to axios' timeout option; persists via existing setCustomEndpointConfig/localStorage path with zero UI change. Diff +14/-1 client, +20 tests (config honored, invalid value falls back to default).
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): configurable per-request timeout for BYOK endpoints

completed_targets.target: Distinguishable 401 error when no API key is configured
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: a keyless misconfigured hosted provider surfaced a raw 'AI Provider Error (401)' only after a full round trip with no hint. After: sendChatCompletion appends an actionable hint ('No API key is configured... set one in AI preferences') only when status is 401 AND no key is set; keyed 401s pass through untouched. Diff +10/-1 client, +27 tests.
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): hint missing API key on 401 provider errors

completed_targets.target: Fail loudly on malformed model JSON in customCreateAiGeneratedEvent
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: a non-JSON model response silently produced a successful EMPTY event insert (isEventsJsonValid: true, creationSucceeded: true) — the user saw 'success' with zero events; a non-array generatedEvents payload went to the sheet unchecked. After: non-JSON responses fail with an actionable message, and generatedEvents (string or array) must parse to a JSON list or generation fails. 3 new tests (invalid JSON, non-list generatedEvents, valid string-array payload). Diff +40/-12 client, 37/37 tests green.
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): reject malformed model JSON in event generation
